# Reproducible runtime for the HKUST 15-minute LSTM--MPC integration.
# Supported interpreters: CPython 3.10 and 3.11.
#
# pytorch-lightning 1.5.10 has legacy requirement metadata which pip 24.1+
# rejects.  Create/activate the virtual environment, then install with:
#
#   cd external/ol-ems-hkust
#   python -m pip install "pip==23.3.2" "setuptools==59.5.0" "wheel==0.42.0"
#   python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
#   python -m pip install --no-build-isolation --no-deps -e ../python-microgrid-hkust
#
# The final command installs the vendored python-microgrid 1.4.1 source in
# editable mode.  It supplies the `pymgrid` import used by
# src/plants/pymgrid_adapter.py; do not replace it with an unrelated package
# named `pymgrid` from PyPI.

# Packaging compatibility required by pytorch-lightning 1.5.10.
setuptools==59.5.0
wheel==0.42.0

# Numerical stack.  These versions retain APIs used by python-microgrid 1.4.1.
numpy==1.23.5
pandas==1.5.3
scipy==1.10.1
scikit-learn==1.2.2
statsmodels==0.13.5

# Forecasting and training.  PyTorch selects the platform wheel; do not add
# unconditional nvidia-*-cu11 or triton pins on macOS.
torch==2.0.0
pytorch-lightning==1.5.10
torchmetrics==0.11.4
tensorboard==2.12.0

# Keep legacy Lightning/TensorBoard consumers on compatible APIs.
fsspec==2023.3.0
packaging==23.0
protobuf==3.20.3

# Differentiable convex optimisation.  The solver patch releases below have
# Python 3.11/macOS arm64 support while preserving the CVXPY 1.3 APIs.
cvxpy==1.3.0
cvxpylayers==0.1.5
diffcp==1.0.21
ecos==2.0.14
osqp==0.6.7.post3
scs==3.2.4.post3

# python-microgrid 1.4.1 runtime dependencies.
gym==0.26.2
cufflinks==0.17.3
plotly==5.13.1
PyYAML==6.0
tqdm==4.65.0

# ol-ems plotting and local tuning utilities.
matplotlib==3.7.1
SciencePlots==2.0.1
tikzplotlib==0.10.1
webcolors==1.12
syne-tune==0.4.1
tabulate==0.9.0

# Test runner.
pytest==7.2.2
